task_description: The function `sum_range(a, b)` returns the sum of integers from a to b inclusive, but it currently excludes b. Fix the off-by-one error.
The function `find_max(lst)` raises AttributeError when called on an empty list because it returns None and the caller accesses .value on the result. Add a guard that returns None gracefully.
The function `divide(a, b)` uses integer floor division `//` but should use true division `/`. Fix the operator so `divide(7, 2)` returns 3.5.

The function `sort_descending(lst)` is broken. A first fix attempt using `sorted(lst)` passes the smoke test but fails the ordering assertion. You must rollback and use `sorted(lst, reverse=True)` instead.
The function `get_user_score(data, user_id)` raises KeyError when user_id is missing. It should return 0 as a default. Fix it using `.get()` with a default.
The function `concatenate(a, b)` raises TypeError when b is an integer instead of a string. Add type coercion so it works for any scalar b.

The `authenticate(token)` function in auth.py returns True for all non-empty tokens. A first fix that checks `len(token) > 8` still fails the constant-time comparison test. Rollback and implement hmac.compare_digest instead.

The function `fetch_all(urls)` uses `asyncio.run()` inside a loop, which raises RuntimeError when called from an already-running event loop. Refactor to use `asyncio.gather()` in a single event loop call.
